text: A starting point for running a lights-on software factory with Claude Code. Based on the setup developed for Votito , where the orchestrator reduced token spend compared to bare-bones Claude workflow execution by around 80%. See gojko.net/slides/202609-gotocph.pdf for a quick overview. The purpose of this repository is to act both as a simple boilerplate setup for new projects, and as an educational demonstration of the core concepts of software factories: This repository provides setup for: The workspace directory contains Claude code setup and a trivial example project. To set up the container and run a first change, start with GETTING-STARTED.md . . ├── README.md this file ├── GETTING-STARTED.md first setup and a first change ├── SETTINGS.md what settings.local.json wires up ├── LINTER-HOOK.md the lint hook and custom lint rules ├── REGULATOR.md the Bash-command regulator ├── ORCHESTRATOR.md how the orchestrator works inside ├── WORKFLOW.md the user flow, from an idea to a finished run ├── CONTAINER.md the container image and the root goals ├── LICENSE ├── makefile container goals: docker-image, init, claude, shell, test, lint, root ├── vm/Dockerfile the container image (Alpine, Node.js, make, git, ...) ├── .gitignore ├── .claude-home/ git-ignored; Claude Code login and history of the container └── workspace/ the project; `make claude` starts Claude Code here ├── CLAUDE.md includes CONTRIBUTING.md for Claude Code ├── CONTRIBUTING.md workspace layout, commands and rules ├── .claude/ │ ├── settings.local.json hooks, env, permissions, preferences │ ├── agents/ workflow-worker, workflow-gate, workflow-check │ ├── commands/ impact-analysis, plan-execution, execute, regulator │ └── workflow/ │ ├── README.md plan notation and generator reference │ ├── package.json {"type": "module"} for the tooling │ ├── bin/ hook entries and command-line tools │ ├── src/ │ │ ├── regulator/ regulator engine, rules.js, rules/ │ │ ├── generator/ plan validator and workflow generator │ │ ├── lint/ eslint plugin, two rules, lint hook logic │ │ └── transient-dir.js │ └── tests/ tests for all of the tooling ├── plans/ plans, sidecars and progress records ├── src/format-greeting.js sample module (replace it) ├── tests/format-greeting.test.js ├── eslint.config.js ├── makefile init, test, lint and the two workflow gate goals ├── package.json ├── package-lock.json └── .gitignore Further reading GETTING-STARTED.md — start here: set up the container, start Claude Code and run a first change. SETTINGS.md — the hooks, environment, permissions and preferences in workspace/.claude/settings.local.json . LINTER-HOOK.md — the lint-on-edit hook, the two example rules and how to write a rule. REGULATOR.md — how the regulator decides, the roles, the notable rules, diagnosing a decision, configuring it and adding a rule. WORKFLOW.md — the user flow: /impact-analysis , /plan-execution , /execute , watching and resuming a run, /regulator , and a worked example. ORCHESTRATOR.md — how the orchestrator works inside: the pieces, the bins, the agents, the gate goals, progress and resume. CONTAINER.md — the container image, the root goals, mounts, overrides, keeping node_modules in the container, troubleshooting. workspace/.claude/workflow/README.md — the plan notation, the run shape, the answer schemas and the fault list.
